about: The register of every vault b.vault.keeper knows of and every public read link, by Dinis's word in record 2026-11-28__media-in-vault (Site__Agent__Decisions 02529d1). No vault key, write key or private read key is ever kept here: a public read key is pointed to where it is published, with a fingerprint so anyone can check it.
fingerprint_rule: read_key_fp = first 16 hex characters of sha256 over '<read key hex>:<vault_id>' (the sgit_public_read_ value without its prefix, with %3A as ':')
